Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the father of Thomas Lyon-Bowes, Lord Glamis, was from Scotland based on the title "11th Earl of Strathmore and Kinghorne," which is a Scottish peerage. However, the birthplace of the 11th Earl of Strathmore and Kinghorne was explicitly stated as Durham, England, in the information provided by WebSurfer. The Planner failed to differentiate between the geographical location of the peerage title (Scotland) and the actual birthplace (England), leading to an incorrect conclusion that the father was from Scotland. This error occurred in Step 7 when the Planner provided the final analysis and conclusion.
